name: IELTS Academic

sections.name: Listening (≈ 30 min)
sections.summary: 4 parts — two conversations and two monologues, including an academic lecture; 40 questions.

sections.name: Reading (60 min)
sections.summary: 3 long academic passages (≈ 2,150–2,750 words in total); 40 questions.

sections.name: Writing (60 min)
sections.summary: Task 1: describe a graph, table, chart or diagram (min. 150 words). Task 2: argumentative essay (min. 250 words).

sections.name: Speaking (11–14 min)
sections.summary: Part 1 interview, Part 2 individual long turn on a topic card, Part 3 discussion.

scoring: Band scores from 0 to 9 in half bands, for each skill and overall. Total test time ≈ 2 h 45 min.

name: TOEFL iBT (format updated January 2026)

sections.name: Reading
sections.summary: Multistage adaptive: difficulty adjusts midway through the section based on your performance.

sections.name: Listening
sections.summary: Multistage adaptive, with academic and everyday listening tasks.

sections.name: Writing
sections.summary: Writing tasks updated in 2026 with more real-world academic contexts.

scoring: Since 21 January 2026: section and total scores on a 1–6 scale in 0.5 steps, aligned with the CEFR. Until January 2028, reports also show a comparable 0–120 score.
